answer: Goldens are generated from the same fixture, so any self-consistent content works; the executor authors it. Fix: say so explicitly, or list exact ids/titles/filenames for the 2 tasks, 2 atoms, 1 pill, 1 drawer task.
Pills live in desk/contexts/ (e.g. desk/contexts/pill-010-graph-runtime-output-policy.md, one of this task's own bindings), so the fixture pill goes at tests/fixtures/golden_desk/desk/contexts/.

deskops graph build --root <root> writes .sldb/runtime/graphs/deskops.kg.json then deskops.nx.json (main.py:246-254); deskops graph reflect --root <root> (parser.py:331-333) reads the default snapshot. No --store/--schema flags exist.

closeout commit itself writes runs/subagents/index.jsonl: manual route appends {task_id,run_id,run_dir,commit,session_sha256,mode:'manual'} (closeout.py:96-108); run route appends the same keys minus mode (closeout.py:186-200).

--run-dir requires the four evidence files board.txt/task.txt/git-status.txt/result-summary.md in a dir under runs/subagents/ (closeout.py:24,127-137). run.yaml is optional: read if present, then rewritten with run_id/session/session_sha256 (closeout.py:139-159).

Route value is undefined. Fix: e.g. {"route":"run-dir"|"no-run","trailers":{...}}, read via `git log -1 --format=%(trailers)`. Note the run route emits Run-Id/Session-Sha256 only when run_id/session are supplied (closeout.py:170-175).

Only the 40-hex commit sha in run_index.jsonl (closeout.py:96-108,186-200) and an optional Session-Sha256 (closeout.py:143-146,173-174) are hashes; snapshot/self-reflection carry none (snapshot.py:73-99, self_reflection.py build_self_reflection_report). Normalizing 40-hex suffices.

parser.py:27-29 hardcodes prog="deskops" and RawTextHelpFormatter; argparse derives help width from shutil.get_terminal_size, so goldens depend on COLUMNS. Pin COLUMNS=80 (or a fixed width) in the help-golden path.
prog="deskops" is hardcoded (parser.py:27), so help shows paths like `deskops graph build`, never argv[0] or `python -m deskops`. No program-name normalization rule is needed.

Any recursion over argparse subparsers yields the same set as 'reachable from --help'; the deprecated `inbox` alias is a real top-level command (parser.py:498-500) that appears in help, and there are no hidden commands.

graph build/reflect/closeout need no store (test_graph_snapshot.py:24 builds a snapshot with no init; extract_sources.py:84 walks files), so step 2 omits init correctly, but Resolved Decisions says CLI tests run it. Fix: state golden_desk is used as-is.

No: graph extraction reads the filesystem, not git (extract_sources.py:84 rglob; extract_docs), and nothing under deskops/graph/ calls git. Tracked/untracked state does not change the snapshot; only closeout staging needs commits.

Neither is required: --task is a free string made into the Task-Id trailer; closeout commit never reads the task doc or verifies promotion (closeout.py:39-115,170). The executor may close either fixture task.

Standard setup: _make_repo configures user.email/user.name (test_closeout.py:29-31); committer dates never appear in the captured outputs, and the commit count (seed + 2 closeouts) is fixed by the test's own steps.

tests/conftest.py already exists with the lifecycle_desk fixtures used suite-wide (conftest.py:16-40; tests/test_cli.py:1440). 'Create it with only --update-golden' would delete them. Fix: add pytest_addoption to the existing file; keep normalization helpers in the test module.

Snapshot writer is deskops/graph/snapshot.py build_graph_snapshot (snapshot.py:73); renaming SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA (snapshot.py:19) or metadata keys "node_count"/"edge_count" (snapshot.py:84-99) makes graph_snapshot.kg.json stop matching.

Completeness is self-referential (the test's own enumeration defines the set) and stale/extra help files are unchecked. Fix: assert the help/ file set equals the enumerated command paths (set equality or an exact count).
